# Abrarr Tallks (Abrar Ali)

> Abrar Ali, known professionally as Abrarr Tallks, is a web designer, developer, Meta Ads expert and SEO specialist based in Srinagar, Jammu & Kashmir, India. He is CEO of [rebrar.in](https://rebrar.in) and [makemetop.in](https://makemetop.in), and founder of [Kashmir Stay](https://kashmirstay.in). He has 4+ years of experience and has delivered 20+ live websites for clients in India, the USA, UK, UAE, Maldives, Australia, Canada and Singapore.

## Facts
- Full name: Abrar Ali
- Professional name: Abrarr Tallks
- Role: Web Designer, Web Developer, Meta Ads Expert, SEO Specialist
- Companies: CEO of [rebrar.in](https://rebrar.in) (web design & development agency) and [makemetop.in](https://makemetop.in) (MakeMe Top Business Profile, digital marketing & SEO)
- Founder of: [Kashmir Stay](https://kashmirstay.in) — Kashmir tourism and hospitality booking platform
- Based in: Srinagar, Jammu & Kashmir, India — 191101
- Experience: 4+ years, 20+ live websites delivered
- Contact: WhatsApp +91 7051078832, email contact.abrarrtallks@gmail.com
- Areas served: Srinagar and all 10 districts of Kashmir (Pulwama, Ganderbal, Budgam, Baramulla, Anantnag, Kupwara, Bandipora, Shopian, Kulgam), Jammu division, and international clients in the USA, UK, UAE, Maldives, Australia, Canada and Singapore

## Services
- Website design & development (business, e-commerce, tourism/booking, real estate)
- Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram) management
- SEO, AEO (answer engine optimization), GEO (generative engine optimization), SXO (search experience optimization)
